meaning: older brother's wife; sister-in-law (elder brother's wife)

example.romanization: A-sau chu ke choi tong hau shit.
example.english: My sister-in-law's cooking is really delicious.

note: Hakka speakers also use 阿嫂 as a polite way to address a married woman of one's elder brother's generation, even if she is not a relative. It pairs naturally with 阿哥 (elder brother).
